podcast.body: Kendrick Lamar made a guest appearance on Big Sean's 2013 track "Control." Lamar used this opportunity to turn the song "into a diss extravaganza," taking aim at numerous leading rappers from veterans to contemporary hitmakers, igniting a significant wave of responses in the rap world. "Lamar was invited to make a guest appearance on this track by Big Sean, 2013's Control."

podcast.body: On Big Sean's 2013 track "Control," Kendrick Lamar's guest verse became a "diss extravaganza," where he explicitly "took aim at many of the leading rappers rocking the mic." His targets ranged from veterans such as Jay-Z, Nas, and Eminem, to contemporary hitmakers like J. Cole, Pusha T, A$AP Rocky, and Drake. "On his verse, he took aim at many of the leading rappers rocking the mic."
